tools.name: uk_company_search
tools.description: Search the UK Companies House register by name or number. Returns candidate companies with number, status, type, incorporation date and registered address, with provenance. Primary source with retrieval timestamp; cached for up to 24 hours.

tools.name: uk_company_profile
tools.description: Full Companies House profile for a company number: status, SIC codes, registered office, accounts and confirmation statement dates, plus the first page of officers (up to 35), with explicit total/coverage metadata. Primary source, cached for up to 24 hours, provenance attached.

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a legal entity to its Legal Entity Identifier via the GLEIF API, by LEI or by name. Returns LEI, legal name, jurisdiction, status and registration dates. CC0 source data, provenance attached.

tools.name: sanctions_screen
tools.description: Screen a person or entity name against sanctions lists loaded directly from primary government sources (configurable: OFAC SDN and consolidated, the UK Sanctions List). Returns match verdict, candidate hits with scores, list versions and retrieval timestamps. Not a PEP or adverse-media screen.

tools.name: entity_match
tools.description: Compare two company references using supplied company-number/LEI equality and normalised name similarity. When one reference has a UK company number and the other only a name, optionally corroborates against Companies House. LEIs are compared as supplied, not validated against GLEIF by this tool. Re

tools.name: uk_psc_ubo
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: resolved beneficial-ownership chain for a UK company from PSC data, entity-resolved across registries. Calling this records your requirement and returns a structured not-covered response.

tools.name: cross_registry_resolve
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: resolve a company across Companies House, GLEIF, OpenOwnership and sanctions lists into one entity record with per-assertion provenance. Calling records the ask and returns not-covered.

tools.name: pep_screen
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: politically exposed person screening. Calling records the requirement and returns a structured not-covered response. Sanctions-only screening is live at /v1/screen/sanctions.

tools.name: adverse_media
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: adverse media screening with citations. Calling records the requirement and returns not-covered.

tools.name: uk_director_changes
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: per-entity change feed for officer appointments and resignations, priced per delta. Calling records the requirement and returns not-covered.

tools.name: uk_insolvency_notices
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: structured Gazette insolvency notices for a monitored entity, per event. Calling records the requirement.

tools.name: fca_register_check
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: authorisation status of a firm or individual on the FCA register. Calling records the requirement.

tools.name: kyb_verdict
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: single-call KYB verdict (exists, active, officers, PSC, sanctions, insolvency) with signed provenance receipt. Calling records the requirement and returns not-covered.

tools.name: vessel_sanctions
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: screen a vessel (IMO, name, flag) against sanctions designations. Calling records the requirement.

tools.name: uk_procurement_awards
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: contract awards for a supplier from Find a Tender OCDS data. Calling records the requirement.

tools.name: eu_vat_check
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: VIES VAT validation with provenance. Calling records the requirement.

tools.name: registry_doc_fetch
tools.description: Roadmap probe, not yet served: fetch and parse a specific Companies House filing into structured JSON. Calling records the requirement.
